description: This file defines repository interfaces and their concrete implementations for managing customers, outages, and jobs within a backend service, utilizing Dapper for database operations with MySQL. It includes methods for CRUD operations, listing with filters and pagination, and associated data handling for outage updates and job status events.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ICustomerRepository, managing customer data retrieval and search.

classes.name: OutageRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IOutageRepository, handling outage data including creation, updates, retrieval, and listing with filters.

classes.name: JobRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IJobRepository, managing job records, including creation, assignment, status updates, and retrieving job status events.

methods.name: GetCustomerByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a customer by ID if the role is 'customer'.

methods.name: SearchCustomersAsync
methods.description: Searches customers by query string with pagination within an organization.

methods.name: GetOutageAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an outage by its ID.

methods.name: ListOutagesAsync
methods.description: Lists outages filtered by organization, status, severity with pagination.

methods.name: CreateOutageAsync
methods.description: Creates a new outage along with associated location and initial update.

methods.name: UpdateOutageStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an outage and logs the change.

methods.name: AddOutageUpdateAsync
methods.description: Adds an update entry to an outage, returning the created update details.

methods.name: ListJobsAsync
methods.description: Lists jobs with optional filtering by status and outage, with pagination.

methods.name: CreateJobAsync
methods.description: Creates a new job and logs the creation event.

methods.name: AssignJobAsync
methods.description: Assigns a crew and user to a job and logs the assignment.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of a job and logs the change.

methods.name: GetJobStatusEventsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves status change events for a specific job.
